name.en: Refreshing Lime and Ice in Water
name.uk: Освіжаюча вода з лаймом і льодом

alt.en: Refreshing Lime and Ice in Water
alt.uk: Освіжаюча вода з лаймом і льодом

description: Slices of vibrant green lime are immersed in a sparkling liquid, creating a refreshing and lively scene. The lime slices are surrounded by numerous tiny bubbles, indicating carbonation, which adds a sense of effervescence and freshness. The translucent ice cubes intermingle with the lime, enhancing the cool and invigorating atmosphere. The bright green of the lime contrasts beautifully with the clear, bubbly liquid, making the image visually appealing. The close-up perspective highlights the texture of the lime's rind and the clarity of the ice, emphasizing the freshness and zestiness of the composition.
